nom: ANUA 8 Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Gentle Gel Cleanser

avis.texte: kinda burned my skin at first and purged for the first week or so but after that it felt super light and helped with my face redness!!

TLDR: So gentle, fragrance-free / sensitive friendly, and leaves skin sooo soft, but struggles a bit with oily T-zones or as second cleanse to oil cleansers because it is so gentle. People with dry skin who don't want a cream cleanser would love! I'll repurchase next tine theres's a special, even though I have to use more / spend more time on my oilier T-zone. I love this foaming cleanser. It is incredibly gentle on my sensitive, combo, mildly acne-and clog- prone skin. Since switching for several weeks now, my acne has improved some and my face feels so soft and smooth after washing, never tight, even in the dry winter. It is, however, almostttt too gentle on my oilier T-zone in the morning. I usually have go back and either add more gel to those areas while still washing or rinse and go back with a second wash on my T-zone to feel good about my leave-on products getting good penetration. With other foaming cleansers (Korean and otherwise), I've been able to get away without double-cleansing off my Thank You Farmer chemical SPF on no-makeup days, but I definitely cannot with this one. This cleanser works fine with micellar water, but it struggles a bit to get off the "film" I feel from even very highly recommened oil cleansers. Still likely to repurchase the next time it's on special!

Very gentle and hydrating. I wish Ulta had this available to buy in store instead of just online. By far my favorite Anua cleanser (I've tried all three). It's very delicate. I think it's best for sensitive skin and/or those with skin barrier issues. It lathers well, and my face always feels clean and refreshed.
This cleanser is great. I am oily acne prone, but get dry after washing and this is fantastic Plus a little goes a long way because it is thick at first but lathers well

avis.titre: never using a cream cleanser again!
avis.texte: This was my first time using a gel cleanser and let me tell you, I was blown away. My skin felt so nourished the minute this was on. So lightweight and hydrating. Love love love love that! As a sensitive skin girly, it's extremely gentle and is absolute magic if used as directed (after an oil cleanser).

avis.titre: Cleanser that hydrates, but doesnt clean
avis.texte: Leaves skin soft because ita hydrating, but maybe because it doesn't clean. It's a cleanser that doesn't clean very well. Always have to go heavily on the micellar water to get the rest of my makeup off.

As someone with combination, acne-prone, super sensitive skin this really saved my skin. Has not broken my skin out once. I use this and their glow milky toner and have noticed such an improvement in my skin barrier, skin texture, and acne in less than 3 weeks.

I have oily sensitive skin and have been using the same face wash for years, but it was out of stock everywhere, so I got this one and my skin has improved so much over the few weeks I've been using it! My redness on my cheeks is better and the texture of my skin is so much smoother!

OMG!!! I have sensitive, acne-prone skin that is dry and gets perioral dermatitis. Vanicream is my go to cleanser but I have been looking for something more hydrating. Ive been using this for a month and theres no irritation at all, it truly cleans my skin, and leaves it so soft! HIGHLY recommend!
This product is truly so moisturizing and cleared my skin up so much.
